short: Thomas More was an English lawyer, philosopher and statesman who served as Lord Chancellor and was executed for refusing to acknowledge Henry VIII as head of the Church.
full:
A leading Renaissance humanist, Thomas More gained international fame for his 1516 book *Utopia*, which coined the word to describe an ideal island society. As Lord Chancellor, he was a zealous opponent of the Protestant Reformation, orchestrating the burning of heretics and strongly opposing the king's separation from the Catholic Church.

When Henry VIII broke with Rome to marry Anne Boleyn, More resigned his chancellorship. His refusal to take the Oath of Supremacy, which repudiated papal authority and recognised Henry as Supreme Head of the Church of England, led to his trial for treason. Convicted on the perjured testimony of Richard Rich, he was beheaded on Tower Hill in 1535, declaring himself "the king's good servant, but God's first."
